modules.module_title: Assist in preparing the culture unit

pcs.pc_description: drain the culture unit and sun-dry it
remove the aquatic weeds and predatory/ weed fish using the recommended method
apply organic manure/ inorganic fertilizer in the pond/tank as per the instructions
apply the recommended treatment in the pond to control aquatic insects before stocking seeds
maintain the record of fertilizers and any treatments applied in the pond

modules.module_title: Assist in refilling the water body based on requirement

pcs.pc_description: draw water from the source up to the required level in the reservoir
assist in treating the water with the appropriate methods such as chlorination
monitor the inlet and outlet of water body
pump the treated water to the culture unit from the reservoir
segregate waste into appropriate categories and deposit at identified locations
dispose the non-recyclable waste appropriately

pcs.pc_description: acclimate the seeds as per the instructions of the supervisor/ aquaculture technician
remove weak and dead seeds following the netting process
stock the seeds at an appropriate density and species ratio

modules.module_title: Assist in post-stocking pond culture operations including periodic sampling

pcs.pc_description: carry out feed mixing as per the ration
feed seed stock with the recommended quantity of feed and supplementary feed as per the schedule prescribed by the supervisor/aquaculture technician
carry out split feeding as per the instructions of the aquaculture technician
carry out netting operation and periodic sampling of the soil, water and fish
apply manure, fertilizer, lime and therapeutics as recommended by the supervisor
adhere to the recommended guidelines for aeration and water replenishment in the culture pond
carry out regular repair and maintenance of the implements, nets and gears, pond dyke, etc.

modules.module_title: Assist in harvesting and post-harvest management of fish

pcs.pc_description: use nets of appropriate mesh size to harvest the fish
harvest fish of the size as advised by the aquaculture technician, in case of partial harvesting
carry out minimum handling of the fish between harvesting and transportation
wash and clean the fish storage boxes and containers
crush and keep sufficient quantity of ice for hygienic storage of fish
store the harvested fish in appropriate container at the recommended temperature and Relative Humidity (RH)
pack the harvested fish in appropriate container for transportation
optimise the usage of water, electricity and relevant materials in various tasks and processes
plug any water leakages to prevent its wastage

modules.module_title: Assist in maintaining the water level and quality and waste disposal systems

pcs.pc_description: control the inlet and outlet system of ponds / tanks
assist in arranging for an alternative water supply before the repair and maintenance of the water system
remove sedimentation and any obstructions from the water pipes
provide bird netting for ensuring water quality
carry out the cleaning of water pipes with the approved cleaning agents such as bleach
repair or replace the faulty or damaged water pipes and fittings as per instructions
assist in reconnecting the water supply system appropriately after repair and maintenance activities
carry out repair and maintenance of the waste disposal system as per the supervisor’s instructions

modules.module_title: Assist in maintaining various tools and equipment

pcs.pc_description: prepare the appropriate repair and maintenance tools, equipment and materials for use as per the supervisor’s instructions
assist in carrying out repair and maintenance of water pump, aerator, blower, air compressor and other aquaculture equipment according to the manufacturer’s instructions
assist in replacing any faulty equipment with the new one
co-ordinate with an expert for complex repair and maintenance needs
assist in testing the aquaculture equipment for the correct functioning after repair and maintenance
carry out maintenance of the repair and maintenance tools and equipment as per the supervisor’s instructions and store them safely at the designated storage
assist in maintaining the record of repair and maintenance of all the equipment

modules.module_title: Maintain the water body and its hygiene

pcs.pc_description: follow the recommended practices to protect the aquaculture farm from different types of threats such as storms, predatory birds, harmful organisms, poachers, etc.
carry out regular maintenance of the dykes and fences in the culture pond
identify and remove the preying organisms from the culture pond or tank
remove sludge, algae, uneaten feed and any other waste materials from the culture pond or tank
apply the necessary disinfectants or preventive treatment in the culture pond or tank to prevent disease outbreak and the growth of harmful organisms

modules.module_title: Maintain the health of cultured organisms

pcs.pc_description: follow the recommended practices to protect the cultured organisms from the air, water or fomite-borne contamination and diseases
sample the cultured organisms regularly to identify the signs of stress/ disease/ phenotypic disorders and the presence of parasites and pathogens
identify, quarantine and treat the unhealthy organisms following the recommended practices
monitor the quarantined organisms for signs of improvement and restock them in the culture pond or tank on complete recovery
remove the dead and moribund organisms and dispose them in an environment-friendly manner
check the relevant Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) before use and repair or replace it, as required
use the relevant PPE during various aquaculture operations such as the application of hazardous chemicals
use the recommended soap or sanitiser to keep hands sanitised
store hazardous chemicals, tools and equipment in the safe storage area to avoid personal harm or injury
administer first-aid to the injured personnel and co-ordinate with the emergency services for further medical attention
